extract.selection_rule: Cheapest supported model passing the extraction fixtures

organize.selection_rule: Cheapest supported model passing the grouping fixtures

repair.selection_rule: Stronger tested model, failing units only

extraction.overflow: Split into topic query bundles; never truncate and label complete

ocr.when_enabled: Unreadable pages only; record method and machine-readability separately

taxonomy_context.routing: Compact global catalogue of all topic IDs and short definitions
taxonomy_context.optimization_gate: Compare against full-catalogue fixtures before reducing detail; never constrain primary_topic_id to the queried domain

extraction.coverage_meaning: Bounded retrieval processing, not proof of exhaustive page review

organization.pre_pack_reconciliation: Reconcile duplicate discoveries from the same document/span AND equivalent proposition; preserve discovery aliases. A shared quote alone is insufficient. Resolve primary-topic disagreement with bounded retagging or keep identity uncertainty visible.
organization.pool_by: Assigned primary and secondary topics across all current document records, irrespective of extraction question
organization.ownership: Primary topic home domain owns the record; other packs receive it as context_only
organization.overflow: Partition by primary topic and named policy object; bounded reconciliation remains Stage 2
organization.required_accounting: Every owned eligible record exactly once in a claim or explicit retained unclassified item; context-only inputs are references, never new ownership
organization.fallback: Retain valid single-record claims with organization_partial; unresolved identity or topic qualification increases uncertainty. Do not publish exact claim totals until accounting/reconciliation completes.

automatic_checks.remaining_failure: Publish diagnostics and incomplete coverage; preserve dated previous snapshot. Unsupported fields do not qualify a band. Never encode missing processing as No evidence found.
automatic_checks.source_integrity: Failed or unreadable required material makes affected topics processing-incomplete. Preserve source-checked positive responses. If affected topics are unknown, mark the required document scope incomplete. Use fixed-denominator coverage bounds.

publication.deadline_is: Configurable unmeasured product defaults. Backfill permits two dependent up-to-24-hour API stages plus overhead; overflow/repairs can still exceed it.
publication.late_completion: A deadline may publish a partial snapshot; later successful jobs automatically create a new complete or more complete snapshot unless superseded by a newer input bundle
publication.while_running: Keep previous published snapshot visible and identify pending changes

cache.incremental: Only changed document units and dependent organization packs rerun

cost.budget_scope: One persisted country-update allowance shared by extraction, organization, overflow reconciliation, SDK/application retries, repairs, search and optional OCR; never reset it per subjob
cost.budget_exhaustion: Reserve estimated cost before dispatch, reconcile actual usage, stop new billable calls at the remaining allowance and publish incomplete coverage. Track ongoing storage separately.
cost.batch: Optional supported offline backfills; Stage 2 starts after Stage 1 batch completes

comparison_profile.topic_set: All 64 topics in the bundled taxonomy; one explicit home_domain_id each
comparison_profile.source_scope: All supplied documents for overview; benchmark cohort must use an explicitly common document-role/date profile
comparison_profile.unset_source_profile: Publish exploratory comparisons with source-scope badge; no normalized rankings
comparison_profile.aggregation: Count each home topic once; band distributions and response coverage P/N to (P+U)/N; never average ordinal codes
